1. Contracting

All buys are placed through Atticor Group LLC dba Lerner & Rowe. Base buy cancellation 4 weeks base · 60 days sports/sponsorship. Contracts go first to jessica.flynn@atticor.ai and are routed to general counsel.

Gross/net · broadcast calendar · within 5 business days of month-end. One invoice per market on multi-market buys.

4. Posting and delivery

Buys post to A25-54; posts due by the 10th for the prior month. The negotiated CPM is the guaranteed posting CPM, cumulative for the flight, on actual impressions. Add UD to reach 100%+ (industry 95%); within one broadcast month or cash suspension. Rotation fair and equal across dayparts and programs; added-value impressions count. Min 85% clearance as placed.

5. Spot placement, makegoods, traffic

15 minutes; credits for missed separation, no makegood. Credit for spots outside ordered dayparts, poor rotation, or non-approved makegoods. Makegoods: Pre-approved, same month, equal or better rate & rating; no month-to-month. Bookends: each end is a separate :15 unit, booked and billed at its own air time. Traffic receipt confirmed monthly; invoice must match traffic; traffic-error credits are final.

6. Holidays — no paid spots

May 31 · Jun 18 · Jul 5 · Sep 6 · Oct 11 — no paid spots. Paid spots on these dates are credited.
